name: NUSEX
summary: A compact historical iron tracking calorimeter in the Mont Blanc tunnel searched for nucleon decay and measured atmospheric-neutrino interactions.
detection_principle: Iron plates supplied target mass while plastic streamer-tube layers recorded charged-particle tracks. Event topology distinguished muon-like tracks and electron-like showers.

results.summary: The measured atmospheric muon-to-electron ratio was compatible with expectation within substantial statistical uncertainty.
